versions.subject: Merge PR #4781 from @nasbench - KamiKakaBot Malware Related Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' /create '
        - 'shutdown /l /f'
        - 'WEEKLY'
filter_main_system_user:
    User|contains: # covers many language settings
        - 'AUTHORI'
        - 'AUTORI'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="* /create *" CommandLine="*shutdown /l /f*" CommandLine="*WEEKLY*" NOT (User IN ("*AUTHORI*", "*AUTORI*"))
